review.en: Some fifty thousand couplets of myth and history, from the first kings to the fall of the Sasanians, written in a Persian kept almost free of Arabic loanwords. The tragedy of Rostam and Sohrab is its best-known episode, but the whole poem is about loyalty under bad rulers and how glory passes. It shaped the language and the painting of Persia for a thousand years.
review.zh: 约五万联诗句，从最初的君王一直写到萨珊王朝的覆亡，所用波斯语刻意少用阿拉伯借词。鲁斯塔姆与苏赫拉布的悲剧最为人熟知，但全诗关心的是在昏君之下如何守住忠诚，以及荣耀如何流逝。一千年来，它塑造了波斯的语言，也塑造了波斯的绘画。
